_meta.notes: LINE 2 IS BLANK IN BOTH COLUMNS - the filer skipped 'TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE' entirely even though Line 6 (which is supposed to copy Line 2 Column A) carries $25,317.88. Both Line 2 cells are recorded as '' (the cell exists and was left blank), NEVER as 0 and never back-filled from Line 6. Cents are written as raised superscripts over a rule (21,581 superscript 66; 7029 superscript 48; 28,611 superscript 14; 3,293 superscript 26) and transcribed with a decimal point; Line 1 Column B uniquely uses a real decimal point ($38,485.96). The Type-of-Report block uses the generic (undated) box labels; the manifest calls this the October interim, and the box actually checked is 'Seven days before a general election' - consistent with an October filing (signed 10-26-10, clerk-stamped OCT 26 2010). Form arithmetic checks out using Line 6: 7,029.48 + 21,581.66 = 28,611.14; 28,611.14 - 25,317.88 = 3,293.26.
